questions.text: Which answer expresses the message of the cartoon?
answers: A: The cartoon illustrates that people are always in a hurry.
B: The cartoon illustrates that people spend too much time in pubs.
C: The cartoon illustrates that people prefer virtual friends to real ones.
D: The cartoon illustrates that people are careless when using the internet.
